# Cncf Spacelift Reviewer

Review Spacelift using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Continuous Integration &amp; Delivery category. Spacelift is a flexible management platform for Infrastructure as Code. It helps customize your workflows, automate manual tasks, reduce number of errors, improve security and auditability of your infrastructure.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
